title: Computations.
bodyText: Computations required by section 383-168(4) shall be made by the director, in accordance with regulations prescribed by the United States Secretary of Labor.
bodyHtml: §383-174  Computations.  Computations required by section 383-168(4) shall be made by the director, in accordance with regulations prescribed by the United States Secretary of Labor. [L 1971, c 187, pt of §13; am L 1982, c 58, §4]
